creature_families.family: monster bodies (named variant ladders, brutes, dragons, serpents, insects, elementals, undead, animated weapon, bird boss)
human-typed bodies incl. elf and gargoyle sets

top_creatures.label: Armoured horned brute with armour-tier variant bodies
top_creatures.why: One silhouette, three body IDs for three armour tiers, so a tier is a body swap. Big horned outline should read at 375 wide. Signature: three melee attacks, a stumble and get-hit reactions.
top_creatures.keep: Body-ID variant ladder for one family; attack set from the monster clips
top_creatures.change: Our own plating shapes; a tier colour on the rim; resolve the duplicate ID 281 (Equipment at line 248, Monster at line 943)

top_creatures.label: Dragon family split into variant bodies (winged, wolf-type, large undead)
top_creatures.why: Several dragon bodies give a tier ladder without new rigs.
top_creatures.change: Our wing silhouette and element palette; add a flight or hover clip (the monster enum has none)

top_creatures.label: Multi-head serpent boss
top_creatures.why: Multi-head outline reads at a distance. Attacks have no per-head clip; the monster branch passes raw indices through for MonsterAction.
top_creatures.change: Our head count and attack timing; custom action indices for each head

top_creatures.label: Armoured insect and mechanical scorpion
top_creatures.why: Plated insect silhouettes are very readable and suit a metal finish.
top_creatures.keep: Insect body with plates and a metallic sheen
top_creatures.change: Our leg count and metal palette

top_creatures.label: Lava elemental
top_creatures.why: Rock-and-heat body with a hot palette reads as danger.
top_creatures.keep: Elemental made of stone and heat
top_creatures.change: Our glow ramp, and an idle that is not a plain stand

top_creatures.label: Undead winged gargoyle
top_creatures.why: Horned, winged, grey-stone silhouette; the donor has gargoyle bodies for both sexes and a gargoyle pet.
top_creatures.keep: Horned and winged outline in grey stone
top_creatures.change: Our horn and wing shape; a spectral glow. Gargoyle race (IsGargoyle) has no caller in the box

top_creatures.label: Animated weapon creature
top_creatures.why: A weapon that comes alive is a strong readable silhouette at 375 wide and bridges weapons and creatures.
top_creatures.keep: The weapon shape itself as the body
top_creatures.change: Our own weapon, its own sound, a glow on the blade

top_creatures.label: Undead caster boss
top_creatures.why: A robed caster reads as magic coming.
top_creatures.keep: Caster boss with a dark aura
top_creatures.change: A real cast clip: the monster enum has no cast index (only humanoid has Cast_Directed and Cast_Area)

looks.label: Brightness-ramp hue recolour
looks.technique: grey level of the sprite indexes a per-hue ramp row in a lookup texture

looks.label: Partial hue for trims
looks.technique: only neutral (grey) pixels take the tint; coloured pixels survive

looks.label: Fixed base lighting mix
looks.technique: 0.8 base plus 0.2 normal-dot-light term in the pixel shader

looks.label: Stencil-gated ground shadow
looks.technique: opaque pixels write one half-transparent dark pixel; stencil gate in C# not read

looks.label: Minimap colour key (hazard)
looks.technique: magenta pixel replaced by minimap texture; any real magenta is replaced too

looks.label: Rolling 256 px minimap
looks.technique: 48x48 cache of 8-tile blocks; full redraw only when centre jumps more than one block

looks.label: Minimap reticle blink and size cycle
looks.technique: 250 ms blink; double click toggles small and large; hidden to small to large to hidden

looks.label: Lightning flash
looks.technique: 10-frame UI sprite sequence tracking the source each update

looks.label: Projectile with impact child
looks.technique: travel time 75 ms per tile of distance, straight lerp, heading from atan2; impact child queued at launch and fired on end

looks.label: Constant-acceleration particle position
looks.technique: position from the integral of a linear velocity change, in the vertex shader; file is deprecated and not wired into the path read

looks.label: Carried light changes walk
looks.technique: walk and run switch to armed sets when a light source is carried

looks.label: Animal and monster idle set
looks.technique: animal graze, fidget and lie-down; monster fidget 1 and 2

originals.name: Armour-tier brute
originals.idea: One brute body; the zone data field picks a body variant per armour tier, so tier is a body swap, not a new model.
originals.keep: One body, variants by tier, no extra rig
originals.change: Our plate shapes, a tier-coloured rim and an armour-break clip. Rows 7 and 23 of the parity checklist.

originals.name: Brightness-ramp finish
originals.idea: Grey art indexed by brightness into a per-finish ramp, with a partial mode so trims keep their colour.
originals.keep: Ramp per finish; partial mode for trims
originals.change: Our hard specular band and a separate channel for hit flash so the highlight survives. Rows 15 and 16.

originals.name: Winged creature with its own fly clip
originals.idea: Winged silhouettes as separate body IDs, selected by a family table.
originals.keep: Wing family keyed by body ID
originals.change: Add the flight clip the donor lacks, and a glide on the death fall. Row 7.

originals.name: Projectile with impact child
originals.idea: Travel time from distance; an impact child fires when the shot lands.
originals.keep: Time from distance; impact on arrival
originals.change: An arc with a cap, and the target fix from defect D2. Rows 10 and 13.

originals.name: Locked chest with whitelist and drop sound
originals.idea: Each container is data: place on screen, drop sound, item whitelist.
originals.change: Drop sound tied to rarity and a rim glow when a valid item hovers. Row 18.

originals.name: Season swap at zone load
originals.idea: A static-ID to variant table applied when the chunk loads.
originals.keep: ID to variant table, applied at load
originals.change: A per-zone season field in zone data, not per chunk; our own variant art. Zones are data on one runtime.

originals.name: Two-number light level
originals.idea: Overall light plus personal light, combined and clamped to a level.
originals.change: Fix defect D4 and add a per-zone night dial. Row 16.

originals.name: Paired-slider stat budget
originals.idea: A fixed point total moved between paired sliders, each with min and max.
originals.keep: Fixed total moved between paired sliders; per-stat min and max
originals.change: Our three stats and class caps, with a visible total. Progression and build diversity.
